book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu numu mee tunedyooe, “Tamme sakwa ooosapa nanetzakwiyino gi oo nasoomukwapana tooe gi yabesoo tamme tu nekwegea sapa.” Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu numu meeoo natugwe'nga,
“Sumu'yoo suta'yoo nana gi ka Te Naa-wi tunaka'oedyukudu, gi numu tutuha soobedyadu, mu numu-nehanedu.
Nonotsa tabeno sumu'yoo peawabe oo-baa petuyina mee oo netammayakwe, ‘Oosoo e wohonedu suda e matugu. U sakwa e tummatzi.’
Wuna'me soo numu-koobatu nehanedu gi oo nakabetsea pana saa'a mee soonamme, ‘Tooe nu gi ka Te Naa-wi tunaka'oedyukuna gi mu numu tutuha soobedyapana, nu sakwa ka peawabe tumayohoku.
Ka nonotsa tabeno e tubenguna e nesagwa'e.’ ”
Mee tuwazoo soo Te Pabe'e unakwe, “Soo suta'yoo nana numu-nehanedu ka peawabe ooosapa pumme nanetsagwayi oo tumayohoku.
Soo Te Naa ka umu tu doodooamu nakasootuhikwu ka nonotsa tabeno mu nanetzakwiyino'o, ka nonotsa togano tuwazoo.
Umu nagutza tubetse wuna'me tuutooe, soo Te Naa yabesoo mu nanekwegeahookwu. Pana ka yaa teepu-koobasoo e kodyu petuse, sumuna mu numu tu'oedyukudu kadoo'yookwu.”
Susumudu numu puusoo besa nasooyugwena kukumma'akoosoo numu suta'yoo mee sooyugwe ooonne'yoona soo Te Pabe'e mee mu natugwe'nga'a.
“Waha'yoo numu-ga ka mu nanesootuhidu tunehane-kwitoo memeakwate. Sumu'yoo ka mu nanesootuhidu Pharisee mee nananeadu-nagatu, sumu'yoo yise tuma'emukwadu.

Soo mu Pharisee-matu ka mu numu-wana wununa nanesootuhiwunu, ‘Ne Naa u tubetse besa'yoo. U nuka besa matabue gi ka numu-wa'nesoo. Nu ooosapa nono'otsa awamooa nanesootuhina pooha tuwunikwu punno'o. Mu susumudu numu suda sukwe manena unu moomoogoobana unu nanidyapu. Soo o wunudu tuma'emukwadu puu ooonne'yoo. Nu gi oo-wa'ne'yoo.’
Soo tuma'emukwadu nasookwina gi oetu poonnena sukwe nanesootuhikooha, ‘Nu tubetse ewa suda manakwe. U sakwa tutuha e soobedyana e tuma'emukwana soomu'wa.’

Ka mu nanesootuhimakwuse soo Te Naa mee unakwe, ‘Oosoo tuma'emukwadu besa manakwe ka tu tuma'emukwana nematzakwunina, nu yise oo sootuhikwu suda oo manepu soomu'wakwu. Soo Pharisee numu togesoo suta'yoo tu tuma'emukwana gi nematzagana, puusoo besa nasooyugwena.’ Tamme ka tammesoo besa nasooyugwena gi hee ka Te Naa-nakwana. Pana tamme ka tammesoo gi maawa'ne'yoo e mee nasooyugwena, o'no soo Te Naa te sootuhikwu.”
Mu numu tu doodooamu tooe Te Pabe'e-baa bi petugonno umu mu nanesootuhiku tuunguna. Mu oo tunakatzimodu ka mu poonnena mu numu nesagwikute ka oo mu manegonno.

Pana soo Te Pabe'e meeoo mu tu nakatzimodu netamma, “Gi mu numu mu dooamu hane petugonnodu nedagonnopana. Mu tututsekoo dooake nu sootuhikwu.” Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo unakwe, “Nu kaaheno mu tuukwekwu. Soo tuha'yoo ka ha'yoo oo tuukwe oo naka'oedyukukwu. Mu sakwa ka tuha'a-kwa'ne tunaka'oedyukuna mu ka Te Naa-baa petugakwu.”
Sumu'yoo numu moohedu ka Te Pabe'e meeoo tubenga, “U tubetse besa'yoo nana. Ha'oo besa sakwa tuwow nu manese namagwetzoi?”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo oo nanekwegea, “U haa'a mee e netamma, ‘U besa'yoo,’ gi haga besa'yoo, Te Naa suu'mu besa'yoo.
U oo sopedakwatoo ka Te Naa tamme tuukwepu: gi numu batsapana, gi numu nowuakupana, gi tuduhapana, gi esayipana numu mane-witu, besa tu naa noko tu pea sooyugwena.”
Soo nana yise meeoo oo netamma, “Mooasoo nu tuha'yoona meeoo na'unnedu nakabetseakena.”

Soo Te Pabe'e ka nana unnena nakase mee oo netamma, “U sakwa no'oko u hemma-ma tumuse ka u nahemena ka mu tutuha manedu hanekuse, o'no yise u ewow hee-gakwu ka Te Naa-baa'yoona. O'no u yise nuka nakatzinummekwu.”
Soo nana yise ka oo unnena nakase suda soonamme ka ewow hee-gana, tu hemma unu nenagana.
Soo Te Pabe'e oo poonnepunnena ka nana-witu meeoo netamma, “Oosoo ewow hee-ga'yoo tuheka-ma nasoonatzina gi puusoo namagwetzoi-wa'ne'yoo.”
Mu oo tunakatzimodu ka Te Pabe'e nakase punno'o meeoo tutubenga, “Hownnekoo soo numu yise mesoo namagwetzoi?”
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo unakwe, “Soo numu gi puusoo namagwetzoi-wa'ne'yoo. Pana soo Te Naa suu'mu mu magwetzoikwu.”
Soo Peter yise meeoo oo netamma, “Mooasoo numme no'oko hemma puu ne heegana ma'wugese u-no maneke.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee mu netamma, “Tooe haga tooe, tu nobe ma'wukadu, tu nanumu noko hemma tu hee-gana tu doodooamu tu tubewabe, ka nuka nagena ewowsoo besa no'obatusoo nasootuhikwu, meno'o manakwana. Mu nasootuhikwuna gi moobegwagakwu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e ka Jerusalem-witoo umu tu nakatzimodu sukwesoo nesumudoose umu-no yadooana meeoo mu netamma, “Tamme ka Jerusalem-wi petugase, soo Te Naa yadooawabe o'nosoo nu-witu tubotugu oto nanemamakwu. Umu numu tutunehanedu nu-ma tzakadukwuse, ka mu tibo'o-matoo e tzamunase umu yise e batsakwu.
Umu tibo'o yise e kobitoo toohegonno e wupagetana, yise e batsakwu. Pana nu yise saa'a pahe tabe mease tuusootabuedooa,” mee.
Pana mu oo nakatzimodu yise gi oo nakasopedakwatoo yise meeoo nana'unakwe, “Ha'yoo na'unnedu tamme gi nakasopedakwatoo?”
Ka Jericho tzage'e ka Jesus manekena sumu'yoo gi tubootabuedu nana oonow po-kumaba katuna ka mu numu natummatzi tuunguyakwe.
Esoo gi tubootabuedu nana ka mu ewow numu pukumi meadu meeoo tubenga, “Ha'oo haa'a namanewunu?” mee.
Mu numu yise meeoo oo netamma, “Soo Jesus yaa kemma.”
Soo gi tubootabuedu yise meeoo ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “E Pabe'e e sootuhi.”
Ewa'yoo mu numu oo-na'oonnakwitu yise oo nedayakwe. “Gi unnepana,” mee oo netammayakwe. Pana soo gi tubootabuedu yise pabasoo ka Te Pabe'e yadooadyakwe, “U E Pabe'e, u sakwa e sootuhi.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise yoo'ipetu ka mu numu ka gi tubootabuedu tsaka tuungu. Soo Te Pabe'e ka pu-baa ka gi tubooetabooedu natzaka petuse meeoo oo tubenga,
“Hownnekoo natummatzi u sookwina?” mee. Soo gi tubootabuedu yise meeoo oo netamma, “Nu gi tubootabuena yaatu soopoonne.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo ka gi tubootabuedu netamma, “Mow u ka besa tunaka'oedyukuna, meno'o yise u yaatu poonnekwu.”
Yabesoo yise soo gi tubootabuedu besa manise yaatu besa poonnena ka Te Pabe'e nakwi ka podo meadabekoo. Mu numu ka gi tubootabuedu nana namabesakuse oo poonnese yise ka Te Pabe'e nesookwugi.
